style: Modern pixel art with soft lighting (Style D): a squat green poison toad with warty skin and yellow eyes, a clean dark outline, chunky readable pixels, gentle highlights and shading. Match the character, colours and proportions of the reference image exactly. Side view, the creature facing right. Draw only the creature: no ground, no thread, no rope, no shadow, no effects.
